maria: Quick question  we need a lightweight preview UX for automatic fallback decisions. Minimal scope: replay last 10m, highlight matched requests, and emit an immutable audit row.
ajay: yes. backend API: POST /policies/preview {policy_id, start_ts, end_ts} -> decisions[] (decision_id, ts, type, reason). make decisions idempotent.
dana: UI: scrubber + small list. show human sentence + raw rule YAML. add cost + latency estimate.
leah: audit: decision_id, policy_id, metric_snapshot, action, operator_note (optional). retention: full 7d, aggregated 1y. CSV export.
sam: defaults: sustained = error_rate >=5% for 120s -> route; transient = error_rate >=12% for 30s -> simulate. include hysteresis (min_hold=60s, cooldown=300s).
maria: edgecases: fallback errors, fallback overload, policy loops. need validation at save and a DAG view in console.
ajay: dev note: redact PII in captured inputs, sign exports with KMS. include decision_context token to correlate traces.
ops-bot: preview run started (id: preview-1712460000-1).
maria: thanks  please drop a 1-line blocker if you hit one by EOD.
